recipes.name: Pizza
recipes.content: 1. Roll dough. 2. Add tomato sauce and mozzarella. 3. Bake at 450°F for 15 mins.

recipes.name: Pasta Carbonara
recipes.content: 1. Boil spaghetti. 2. Fry guanciale. 3. Mix eggs and pecorino. 4. Combine all with a splash of pasta water.

recipes.name: Chicken Tacos
recipes.content: 1. Grill chicken strips. 2. Warm corn tortillas. 3. Top with salsa, onions, and fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Beef Stir-Fry
recipes.content: 1. Slice beef thinly. 2. Sauté with broccoli, ginger, and soy sauce. 3. Serve over steamed rice.

recipes.name: Guacamole
recipes.content: 1. Mash 3 avocados. 2. Mix with lime juice, diced onions, and salt. 3. Serve with chips.

recipes.name: Pancakes
recipes.content: 1. Whisk flour, milk, and 1 egg. 2. Pour onto a hot buttered griddle. 3. Flip when bubbles appear.

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
recipes.content: 1. Chop romaine lettuce. 2. Toss with Caesar dressing and croutons. 3. Top with shaved parmesan.

recipes.name: Sushi Rolls
recipes.content: 1. Spread seasoned rice on nori. 2. Add cucumber and raw fish. 3. Roll tightly and slice into rounds.

recipes.name: Lentil Soup
recipes.content: 1. Sauté onions and carrots. 2. Add lentils and vegetable broth. 3. Simmer for 30 mins until soft.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.content: 1. Combine cucumbers, tomatoes, and olives. 2. Add a large cube of feta. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and oregano.

recipes.name: Omelette
recipes.content: 1. Beat 2 eggs. 2. Pour into a non-stick pan with butter. 3. Add cheese and fold when set.

recipes.name: Lasagna
recipes.content: 1. Layer boiled pasta, meat sauce, and ricotta. 2. Top with mozzarella. 3. Bake at 375°F for 45 mins.

recipes.name: French Toast
recipes.content: 1. Dip thick bread in egg and cinnamon mix. 2. Fry in butter until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
recipes.content: 1. Stir-fry rice noodles with shrimp, bean sprouts, and peanuts. 2. Season with tamarind paste.

recipes.name: Bruschetta
recipes.content: 1. Toast baguette slices. 2. Top with a mix of diced tomatoes, garlic, and basil.

recipes.name: Clam Chowder
recipes.content: 1. Cook chopped clams with potatoes, onions, and heavy cream. 2. Serve in a bread bowl.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
recipes.content: 1. Slice zucchini, eggplant, and peppers. 2. Layer over tomato sauce and bake until tender.

recipes.name: Hummus
recipes.content: 1. Blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic, and lemon juice until smooth. 2. Top with olive oil.

recipes.name: Margarita Pizza
recipes.content: 1. Top dough with crushed tomatoes and fresh mozzarella. 2. Bake until charred. 3. Add fresh basil.

recipes.name: Brownies
recipes.content: 1. Melt butter and chocolate. 2. Stir in sugar, eggs, and flour. 3. Bake at 350°F for 25 mins.

recipes.name: Chicken Curry
recipes.content: 1. Brown chicken pieces. 2. Simmer in a sauce of coconut milk and curry spices. 3. Serve with Naan.

recipes.name: Tomato Soup
recipes.content: 1. Simmer roasted tomatoes and vegetable stock. 2. Blend until creamy. 3. Serve with grilled cheese.

recipes.name: Fish and Chips
recipes.content: 1. Coat white fish in beer batter. 2. Deep fry until crispy. 3. Serve with thick-cut fries.

recipes.name: Falafel
recipes.content: 1. Blend chickpeas with parsley and cumin. 2. Form into balls and deep fry until brown.

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.content: 1. Sauté shrimp in plenty of garlic, butter, and lemon juice. 2. Toss with linguine pasta.

recipes.name: Apple Pie
recipes.content: 1. Fill pie crust with sliced apples, sugar, and cinnamon. 2. Cover with crust and bake at 400°F.

recipes.name: Gazpacho
recipes.content: 1. Blend tomatoes, bell peppers, and cucumbers. 2. Chill for 2 hours. 3. Serve cold.

recipes.name: Quiche
recipes.content: 1. Fill a pastry shell with eggs, cream, and spinach. 2. Bake until the center is firm.

recipes.name: Chicken Wings
recipes.content: 1. Bake or fry wings until crispy. 2. Toss in a spicy buffalo sauce. 3. Serve with blue cheese.

recipes.name: Spring Rolls
recipes.content: 1. Stuff thin wrappers with cabbage and carrots. 2. Roll up and fry until golden and crunchy.
